notes.title: the first update for the GuiGui Game will be released!
notes.content:
On Thursday, August 29th, 2024, the first update for the GuiGui Game will be released! 🎉

A variety of new content will be added to enjoy in GuiGui! 🎨

* Casual Game : The GuiGui Maze Escape game will be added with the first update. 🎮
* Cartoon : With the first update, you can enjoy the comic content created by the GuiGui artist. 📚
* Artwork : The first update will allow you to appreciate the artistic works of the artist GuiGui. 🎨
* Achievement System : The first update will introduce some achievements in GuiGui. 🏆
* New Shop Items : Three new paid character items will be added to the shop with the first update. 🛒

All paid character items currently available in the shop, except for Toby, will be sold for a limited period of 4 weeks. (Don't worry, Toby will always be with us in the shop! 😉) The same sales policy applies to all future shop items, including the new paid character items you can meet starting from August 29th through this update. This means that Toad, Kaloula, and Ax GuiGui, which were released simultaneously with the game, will be discontinued after September 11th. You won't be able to purchase these items anymore after that, so hurry up! ⏰

In addition, after this update, enjoy the fun and joy of discovering the various treasure-like moments that Team GuiGui has hidden in the game. 🕵️‍♀️ 
Team GuiGui will continue to listen to your valuable opinions through various channels such as the official Discord and Steam community. We plan to consistently add to the joy of the GuiGui Universe through continuous follow-up updates. 🚀


We ask for your continued support and encouragement. Thank you. 🙏

notes.title: Team GuiGui's message to users
notes.content:
Hello, we're Team GuiGui.

Thank you for enjoying our GuiGui game.

About six hours have passed since its launch, and we have received valuable reports from some people.

I would like to share this with users and convey what our team thinks.

The unfortunate contents that are occurring are as follows.

1. The situation where the product is not being purchased in the store (the screen that appears when you press the house in the game)

It seems that the time is still delayed in the part where it works with the steam server because it is right after launch.
I think it will be processed as soon as possible because I asked the steam support team for support.

2. Even though the game play has been over 3 hours, no items come into the storage box or no other characters come out

This problem is also considered to be similar to the above problem.
There is no problem at all while testing on the developer account, and the problem is different for each account.
It looks like it will be eased or resolved after some time, but Team GuiGui is also watching with interest because it is the core content of the game.
We will continue to track it, check it, and take action.

We will resolve the above situations quickly.

Additionally, the default GuiGui character is a service for first-timers.
Please remember that the basic GuiGui also needs to acquire items like other characters to be touched normally(?).

*Precautions
As there are more users who play, and the items move flexibly, there may be people who acquire more than 65535 items.
Then, there may be an abnormality in the number of steam storage systems, so it is recommended to collect and enjoy various items rather than collecting too many items.
